title: Earthquake Response Simulation
imageAlt: Placeholder preview for Earthquake Response Simulation
summary: An animated simulation of the effectiveness of a student-designed earthquake response system
description: Built an interactive component using Vue 2 and Grapes.js to simulate the design and implementation of an earthquake warning system. Students could choose a layout of sensors for their alarm network, and test their effectiveness against several earthquakes with different epicenter locations. The sensors were able to respond according to which sensor intersected with the earthquake waves first, with response time and casualty numbers responding appropriately.

title: Orbit Simulator
summary: An interactive simulation of orbital mechanics and satellite trajectories
description: Built an interactive component using Vue 2 and d3.js to simulate how velocity and gravity impact the trajectory of a satellite in orbit. The widget visually responded to changes in velocity and gravity inputs with appropriate consequences: crashing to earth, arriving in stable orbit, or flying off into space relative to the size and direction of the input changes.
